description: Editable LLM system prompt + output schema for one of the evaluation judges. The pipeline loads from here; if a record is missing or disabled, the hardcoded default in the judge module is used as fallback.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.description: Stable identifier used by the pipeline to look up this prompt. One record per purpose.

fields.label: Label
fields.description: Human-friendly name shown in the list view.

fields.label: Version
fields.description: Free-text version tag persisted on traces for audit (e.g. 'persona.v2'). Bump on meaningful changes.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Uncheck to make the pipeline fall back to the hardcoded default while you experiment.

fields.label: Temperature
fields.description: Sampling temperature for this judge. Judges want determinism (default 0.0).

fields.label: Max Tokens
fields.description: Upper bound on the judge response length.

fields.label: System Prompt
fields.description: The system prompt sent to the LLM. Static text — no placeholders. The user message is built by the judge module at runtime.

fields.label: Output Schema (JSON)
fields.description: JSON Schema enforced via response_format. Required for structured output. Must remain compatible with the judge module's parse_output() — changing it implies the LLM still produces score, summary, evidence_quotes, warnings and the dimension-specific extras parse_output reads.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Free-text notes (e.g. change log, calibration runs).

name: LMSA Judge Prompt
